character: Original Orelle commune village at 900m. Traditional Maurienne valley architecture. Orelle 3 Vallées gondola (10 min to ski area). Small shops, bakery, post office, church (17th C).
dining: Local village restaurant. Mountain restaurant at Orelle gondola top station.
activities_nearby: Orelle gondola to 3 Vallées (highest lift in Europe — 1,790m vertical to 3,230m). Via ferrata (Maurienne valley). Hiking, snowshoeing.
